articles.chapeau: Depuis novembre 2026, GTA 6 reste officiellement réservé aux consoles, mais certains y jouent déjà sur PC dans un simple navigateur web. Comment une PS5 partagée et quelques lignes de code ont déclenché cet étonnant accès anticipé ?
articles.txt:
Depuis novembre 2026, GTA 6 reste officiellement réservé aux consoles, mais certains y jouent déjà sur PC dans un simple navigateur web. Comment une PS5 partagée et quelques lignes de code ont déclenché cet étonnant accès anticipé ?
Non, Rockstar Games n’a toujours pas sorti de version PC de Grand Theft Auto VI , mais des joueurs ont déjà lancé GTA 6 dans un simple onglet de navigateur sur leur PC. Le jeu est disponible depuis le 19 novembre 2026 uniquement sur PS5 et Xbox Series X|S , sans portage Windows officialisé. Pourtant, une expérimentation communautaire permet déjà de tester Leonida sur ordinateur, sans console chez soi.
Alors que les recherches « GTA 6 sur PC » ou « GTA 6 dans votre navigateur » explosent, entre faux downloads bourrés de malwares et promesses douteuses, une initiative se détache : un ingénieur a ouvert sa propre PS5 au monde entier via le web. De quoi patienter avant un vrai portage PC, mais avec plusieurs contraintes à bien comprendre avant de se jeter sur le premier lien venu.
L’ingénieur espagnol Germán Fernández , alias « @germanfndezz » sur X, a mis en ligne un projet week‑end aussi simple que brillant : sa PS5 , qui fait tourner GTA 6 , est accessible depuis une page web avec une file d’attente. Il résume le concept ainsi, cité par Gamingbible : « Ma PS5 ne fait rien la plupart de la journée, alors je l’ai mise en ligne. Tu fais la queue et quand c’est ton tour tu as la manette. » Concrètement, vous voyez le flux vidéo de sa console dans votre navigateur et, quand arrive votre tour, vos touches contrôlent directement le jeu. Aucun ROM, aucun ISO : la copie de GTA 6 est achetée légalement sur son compte, ce qui rapproche l’expérience du fait de « passer la manette » à un ami plutôt que d’un port pirate. Victime de son succès, le service est temporairement en pause et son créateur insiste sur un point : il ne demandera jamais d’argent ni de financement, seuls les messages sur son Discord officiel font foi.
Techniquement, jouer à GTA 6 dans votre navigateur via ce système revient à du streaming de console, proche d’un PS Remote Play poussé à l’extrême. Votre PC n’exécute rien, il affiche une vidéo interactive, avec un retour de commandes. Résultat : il faut une connexion solide, au moins du niveau des 15 Mbit/s recommandés pour le Remote Play, et accepter de la latence sur les contrôles, des micro‑saccades, voire une image qui se brouille dans les scènes les plus chargées. Autre contrainte majeure, la file d’attente : avec des dizaines de personnes en ligne, obtenir quelques minutes de conduite dans Vice City peut prendre très longtemps, sans sauvegarde liée à votre compte Rockstar Games . C’est un avant‑goût amusant pour joueurs PC frustrés, pas une façon sérieuse de progresser dans l’histoire.
Juridiquement, la ligne est différente d’un faux « GTA 6 PC » à télécharger : Germán Fernández ne distribue aucun fichier du jeu, il partage simplement l’affichage de sa console, là où des projets comme certains ports web de GTA 5 avaient été bloqués pour violation de copyright. En revanche, cette visibilité attire déjà des imitateurs bien moins scrupuleux. Des analystes sécurité ont repéré des exécutables « gta6_installer.exe » de quelques mégaoctets seulement, infectés par des voleurs de données comme Vidar ou WARDEN Stealer , capables de siphonner mots de passe, cookies et comptes Steam. Rappel essentiel : il n’existe aujourd’hui aucune version officielle de GTA 6 sur PC ni dans un navigateur, tout site qui vous demande de télécharger un .exe, d’entrer vos identifiants PlayStation ou de payer pour un accès cloud est suspect. Cette astuce de PS5 partagée reste donc une curiosité gratuite pour jeter un œil à Leonida depuis un PC ou un Chromebook, en attendant que Rockstar Games confirme enfin un vrai portage PC.

articles.t: La folie GTA 6 : démarrage dingue en France, les ventes « physiques » franchissent un cap historique
articles.chapeau: Les chiffres fous du lancement de GTA 6 en France viennent de tomber, et c'est une humiliation historique pour Xbox face à la PS5.
articles.txt:
© Rockstar Games Alors que le raz-de-marée GTA 6 continue d’écraser l’industrie, les premiers chiffres du lancement français viennent de tomber. Le mastodonte de Rockstar Games réalise un exploit quasiment inédit en magasins, tout en confirmant la domination de la PS5.
Depuis sa sortie, GTA 6 phagocyte absolument tout l’espace médiatique. Entre les premiers retours dithyrambiques qui confinent à l’absurde (avec une note de 99/100 sur Metacritic) et les records d’audience déjà pulvérisés dès son premier jour d’exploitation, le blockbuster de Rockstar Games confirme son statut d’anomalie culturelle totale, bien au-delà de la simple sphère vidéoludique.
GTA 6 : quelles différences entre les différentes éditions du jeu ?
Alors que l’on avait déjà les informations officielles concernant le nombre de ventes totales à l’international, avec pas moins de 3,79 milliards de dollars récoltés en 24 heures, on ne disposait pas des chiffres exacts concernant l’exploitation du jeu en France. Des infos que l’on connaît désormais, et si l’hégémonie du tout-dématérialisé semblait avoir définitivement scellé le sort de la bonne vieille boîte en plastique, le lancement de Grand Theft Auto 6 dans l’Hexagone vient de rappeler que la vente « physique » reste durable (pour le moment).
GTA 6, c’est que de l’amour GTA 6 : hold-up chez Sony et K.O pour Xbox Selon les chiffres partagés sur Bluesky par le journaliste Oscar Lemaire, GTA 6 s’est écoulé à pas moins de 1 046 000 exemplaires physiques pour son démarrage en France . Un score fou qui permet au titan de Rockstar de pulvériser la barre symbolique du million d’unités dès sa première semaine de commercialisation. Pour information, le site Alinea Analytics estime le nombre de ventes totales en France à 3 millions.
Une performance qui relève presque du miracle à l’ère des boutiques en ligne. Reste bien sûr une « petite » subtilité : ces fameuses boîtes ne contiennent qu’un code de téléchargement et pas de disque. On se demande bien quelle est la proportion de personnes ayant, en toute bonne foi, cru acheter un disque.
Zelda Ocarina of Time Remake signe l’un des meilleurs lancements de l’histoire de Nintendo
Comme le souligne Oscar Lemaire, ce n’est que la deuxième fois dans l’histoire du marché français qu’un jeu vidéo réalise un tel exploit en sept jours, et très probablement la dernière. Le seul précédent reste évidemment GTA 5 , qui avait fait 120 000 ventes de mieux à sa sortie en 2013, mais à une époque révolue où la part du dématérialisé demeurait encore dérisoire.
Braquage réussi L’autre enseignement majeur de cette première semaine historique concerne la répartition par plateforme, et l’addition s’avère particulièrement salée pour Microsoft. 93 % de ces ventes physiques reviennent ainsi à la version PS5 , ne laissant que des miettes à la concurrence. Un plébiscite massif pour Sony, qui prouve au passage que sa console reste le territoire ultra-majoritaire des acheteurs de boîtes dans l’Hexagone.
Grand Theft Auto 6 est disponible sur PS5 et Xbox Series depuis le 19 novembre 2026.

From Key Cloning To Car Trackers: How 'GTA 6' Is Making Car Theft A Bigger Hassle - Jalopnik
articles.chapeau: Smashing a window or using a slim jim won't work on every car in 'GTA 6.' Some vehicles have keyless ignition, and many are also fitted with trackers.
articles.txt:
Rockstar Games Add Jalopnik on Google: Preferred Source Google Discover Like missions and side quests, stealing cars has always been an integral part of the "Grand Theft Auto" franchise. For "GTA 6," not only have the developers leaned into advanced physics for more realistic car crashes , but car theft itself has evolved into multiple tiers.
While you can still do things the old-fashioned way, like pulling the driver out and taking control of the vehicle, or smashing a window, hotwiring the car, and driving away, those methods won't necessarily work on every car across the fictional state of Leonida. For example, keyless cars can't be hotwired. Even if someone left the doors of their expensive sports car open, you can't simply waltz in and drive away without a key cloner, which you'll only get access to later in the game. Standard and advanced vehicle trackers are also something to keep in mind. (Minor progression spoilers ahead.)
How can you tell if a car is keyless or has a tracker installed? Enter the WAiNK app. Your friend Cal installs it on your phone during a story mission in Chapter 1. The app lets you scan a car to see its make and model and whether it's locked, alarmed, keyless, or fitted with a tracker. Additionally, the app tells you the car's condition, how much it's worth, and what it costs to register should you wish to own it. Keep in mind that although registering stolen cars is how you take ownership of them in "GTA 6," that feature won't be unlocked until Chapter 2, when you meet Moses, who gifts you a slim jim.
Rockstar Games To steal cars without breaking the window or setting off the alarm, you'll need to use a slim jim. It works through a lock-picking minigame when you interact with a locked, unoccupied vehicle. While the method is unlikely to attract unwanted attention, it still won't let you start cars with keyless ignition. For that, you'll need to wait until you're about halfway through Chapter 3, at which point you'll get a key cloner. (It's a phone app you download during a story mission.)
The process itself is similar to using the slim jim, and once it's done, the door unlocks, and you drive away — no need to hotwire the car. As mentioned earlier, you can use the WAiNK app before you try to steal a car to see which sort of tracker it has, among other details. Standard trackers are not that big of a deal — the catch is that you can't take the car to a mod shop for any kind of modifications unless you've registered it as your own.
Cars with advanced trackers, on the other hand, alert the police and pinpoint your location — remember, "GTA 6" has flock-like cameras to track your movements . You'll have to drive really fast to stop the tracker from sending the location signal to the cops. If you slow down, the tracker starts beeping, and you only have a few seconds to speed up before it gives away your location. And, unlike in older "GTA" games, cars in "GTA 6" don't have infinite gas , so keep that in mind as well.

articles.t: 'GTA 6' chapter 1 is so good that I'm afraid to move on to chapter 2
articles.chapeau: Please help me.
articles.txt:
I've run into a very stupid problem with Grand Theft Auto VI , a game I love so far.
Namely, I'm having a surprisingly difficult time moving on from chapter 1 of the game's sprawling crime story. For a couple of real-life days now, I've been sitting on the edge of finishing GTA 6 's opening stanza with very little motivation to move on. At the time of writing, I have literally one story mission left to go before the first chapter ends, and almost nothing of substance left to do otherwise.
But as much as I know I need to break through and see the rest of what GTA 6 has to offer, it's hard to resist the call to just live out Jason Duval's mundane daily routine for eternity.
Warning: There are some light spoilers for early parts of GTA 6's story in the following section.
For those who haven't played GTA 6 yet or are still in the early stages like me, chapter 1 follows Jason's meager existence as a sort of paid goon for Brian, a local boatyard owner who dabbles in drug trafficking on the side. The other protagonist, Lucia, gets out of prison partway through the chapter, but for most of it, she's not playable yet. Most of the story and side missions in chapter 1 focus on Jason doing little odd jobs that occasionally spiral into chaotic violence. He spends time with his girlfriend or buddies and otherwise just kind of chills when he's not doing all the crime stuff.
GTA 6 chapter 1 immediately establishes an endearingly ordinary routine for Jason, at least by action video game protagonist standards. Every in-game day I wake up, feed the pet snake, drink coffee, work out, drink a protein shake, and take a shower before heading out to do whatever it takes to get enough money to set up a nest egg for Jason and Lucia.
While there are some minor gameplay incentives to doing all of that, GTA 6 doesn't outright demand any of it from the player. I'm just doing it because it's a legitimately interesting loop, especially by the standards of big-budget mainstream games. I'm not just endlessly traversing between icons on a map and shooting some bad guys when I get to each one. I feel like an active participant in the everyday lives of two adults, which at the very least is novel for this type of game. It also helps that Brian is voiced by Stephen Root, so you spend most of chapter 1 being yelled at by Buck Strickland , and that's lovely.
I mean, most of my favorite missions so far have barely involved crime at all. The one where Jason and Lucia go to a bar after she gets out of prison is a remarkable virtual rendition of a romantic night out, while I've already lavished the Carly Rae Jepsen mission with praise on this website.
All of that is why I'm having such a hard time moving forward with the main story. I know in my heart that chapter 2 will likely introduce a new setting with new stakes, new mechanics, and an increased focus on crime. And all of that will probably be fantastic in its own right, but it won't be the same as the game I've loved up until now.
And if that's the feeling Rockstar intends to elicit in players when chapter 1 draws to a close, I would say they pulled it off. Maybe even a little too well. Recommended deals for you HBO Max — top pick for premium content

articles.t: 'GTA 6' drives streaming surge for Carly Rae Jepsen's 'Run Away With Me'
articles.chapeau: One of the game's best early missions also highlights one of the 21st century's best pop songs.
articles.txt:
Grand Theft Auto VI is a massive pop culture event that is affecting a whole lot of people from a whole lot of different angles. Arguably, few are benefiting more from the game's launch last week than Carly Rae Jepsen.
The Canadian pop star broke big worldwide with "Call Me Maybe" in 2012 and has followed up with an extremely respectable career that includes a devoted fanbase and eight studio albums, including the recently released Day & Night . However, one of her most beloved (and slightly less-well-known) songs is blowing up on streaming for the first time in a decade thanks to its inclusion in GTA 6 , per Billboard Canada .
That would be "Run Away With Me," the opening track to Jepsen's highly acclaimed 2015 record Emotion . Aside from being featured on GTA 6 's in-game radio station Flash FM, "Run Away With Me" also soundtracks an important early-game mission. According to Billboard and an X account called Carly Rae Jepsen Charts, the song was streamed more than 100,000 times on both Saturday and Sunday, its two biggest individual streaming days since the song was new.
To be clear, this is not necessarily a case of GTA breathing life into an obscure old song. "Run Away With Me" made a small splash on music charts in Canada and a handful of other territories back in 2015, and was a critical darling both at the time and now. But the GTA bump is clearly very real, nonetheless.
Warning: The following section contains spoilers for an early mission in GTA 6 .
If you're curious as to the specific context in which "Run Away With Me" and its iconic distorted saxophone riff are used in GTA 6 , allow me to explain. During the game's first story chapter, players will run into a mission called "Day Release" that involves protagonists Jason and Lucia going to a party on an expensive yacht. Lucia's parole ankle monitor is temporarily disabled for this mission, and the whole idea is that she and Jason get to have a fun day of rich people debauchery together for the first time since she got out of prison.
A few minutes into the mission, Jason and Lucia are invited to ride jet skis with the host of the yacht party, and this is where the "Run Away With Me" needle-drop happens. As the two lovers speed around the waters of a fictional Miami stand-in, Jepsen's catchy chorus reverberates throughout the action. The best part is that the mission keeps going and includes several little gameplay vignettes, most of which are scored by a longer remix of the song provided by Overmono and Pegassi.
What makes this great for those who enjoy both GTA and Carly Rae Jepsen is that the song isn't used just because it's good. It also perfectly evokes the excitement of the early stages of being in love and sonically fits the high-speed action during the mission.
Needless to say, it's been stuck in my head ever since I played the mission a few days ago. I hope it gets there for you, too. Recommended deals for you HBO Max — top pick for premium content

articles.t: Essential GTA 6 Chapter 1 advice before starting ‘point of no return’ Tourist Trap mission
articles.chapeau: After 100 hours playing GTA 6, I know a thing or two about the right - and wrong - things to do when it comes to the defining moment at the end of Chapter 1
articles.txt:
With 100 hours playing GTA 6, I know a thing or two about the right things to do before the defining moment at the end of Chapter 1
I’m well into the end-game content of GTA 6 now after wrapping up the main story and a large chunk of side-missions. But after 100 hours I’ve only got one piece of advice for those still in Chapter 1.
And before we continue, this is a promise that no spoilers lie ahead in this article when it comes to the main storyline around Jason and Lucia.
For GAMINGbible's GTA 6 review , I played through the game at a moderate pace, with a 60 / 40 split of main story content and side-missions / exploration.
In the end it took me around 70 hours to see the end credits and since being dropped back into the open-world I’ve been busy looking for anything I’d missed or left unfinished.
After seeing everyone else play the game, though, I feel somewhat empty inside, because in my playthrough the best part of the game practically passed in the blink of an eye. We're talking about Chapter 1.
In hindsight I’d have liked to have spent a bit longer in Chapter 1. That’s not to say I rushed through it though.
While Jason is free to explore Leonida in its entirety before Lucia even becomes a playable character, I never left Key Lento unless the story missions explicitly told me to.
There’s just enough to do in terms of side-content, but what I’m really missing right now is the roleplaying aspect.
It was something Rockstar co-lead Rob Nelson spoke about in my interview with him, but GTA 6 leans heavily into the idea of Jason and Lucia being your characters.
Jason actually lives what I’d consider to be my ideal lifestyle in Chapter 1, minus the drug-running, obviously.
He’s got a good house, workout equipment on his porch, a boat for fishing and friends he both works and spends time with at the bar nearby. He gets along with his neighbours and is generally free to live how he chooses due to his boss owning the house.
When Lucia re-enters his life it becomes even more ideal. The pair redecorate the house and turn it into a home. While many players have called these segments boring I thought they were lovely.
Unfortunately, I’m locked out of that part of the game due to my save files. The earliest I can go back is Chapter 2.
You can still return to Key Lento once Chapter 1 has ended, but by that point the story has moved on briskly and it’s no longer the same. What I will say, though, is it you left anything valuable at Jason’s house it’ll still be there when you return later on – including any money you left in your stash.
I’ll see Chapter 1 again someday as I plan on replaying GTA 6 eventually, but it’s going to be a while. Until I’ve seen and done everything of note I’ll be sticking to my current save.
For players who are still finding their feet in the game’s first chapter though, you’ve still got time. It’s not too late to make a save file so you can return to this slice-of-life portion of the game later, and I can guarantee you’ll want to.

articles.t: 'GTA 6' on PC: What we know about the PC release
articles.chapeau: 'Grand Theft Auto VI' is here for console gamers, but remains one of the most-anticipated video games of all time on PC.
articles.txt:
Grand Theft Auto VI is available on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S consoles at launch (it will also be available on Xbox Cloud Gaming , with limits).
GTA 6 has no confirmed PC release date. Given Rockstar's history with PC ports, we originally thought gamers were in for a long wait.
An October 2026 report from gaming business media site Gamesbeat reveals a potential PC launch in early 2027, which is sooner than we expected.
Grand Theft Auto VI arrived on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S on Nov. 19, 2026, but PC players will have to wait a while longer. Rockstar has confirmed that the game will not be available for PC gamers at launch, and no PC version has been officially announced yet.
Despite that, we recently got some good news: GamesBeat reports that GTA 6 will get a PC release sometime in Q1 of 2027. GamesBeat has a good track record with unannounced news like this. According to their reporting, the GTA 6 PC release window was confirmed by industry sources familiar with Rockstar's plans. They spoke with the outlet under the condition of anonymity.
Rockstar and Take-Two haven't given an official reason for skipping PC at launch, but a few factors are typically cited when publishers stagger releases this way.
Console hardware is standardized, which tends to make optimization more straightforward than building for the huge range of PC configurations. Some industry data has also indicated that consoles generate higher per-unit revenue, giving publishers an incentive to front-load console sales.
A more cynical take is that Take-Two could just be double-dipping, hoping fans who can't wait for the PC launch will buy the console first, then buy the PC version later. A PC Gamer poll found that 39 percent of respondents said they're fine waiting for a port rather than needing it on day one, suggesting a meaningful share of the PC audience isn't treating the delay as a dealbreaker.
However, there could be another, less financially motivated reason for all of this.
Speaking to YouTuber KiwiTalkz , former Rockstar producer John Ricchio explained that building for consoles first and scaling up to PC is technically easier than the reverse, since consoles have fixed, predictable hardware. According to IGN , Ricchio said it's simpler to start with tighter constraints and add polish later than to build a PC-first game and then try to trim it down to fit console limitations.
Without an official release date, gamers have had to speculate on the most likely launch window for a GTA 6 PC version.
If you look at several past Rockstar games, you can see that there's typically a significant amount of time between the console launch and the PC port.
Grand Theft Auto 4 was released in April 2008 and didn't reach PC's until December. Grand Theft Auto V was released in Sept. 2013, and its PC counterpart was released 19 months later in April 2015. Red Dead Redemption 2 arrived on PC roughly a year after its console release.
The one exception was Grand Theft Auto: The Trilogy – The Definitive Edition , which launched simultaneously across platforms in 2021. Based on that track record, a GTA 6 PC port, if it follows the usual pattern, could be a year or more away.
A report from The Verge claimed that Xbox would have exclusive rights to stream GTA 6 via its cloud gaming service at launch, a claim that was recently confirmed. The report noted that PC gamers would be able to play GTA 6 on day one , despite Rockstar's lack of news about a potential release window for a PC port. Unfortunately, Xbox Gaming's Chief Strategy Officer, Matthew Ball, shot down this report. Ball wrote on his personal X account that The Verge's coverage led to some "misreporting."
Again, the game will be available to play on Xbox consoles via Xbox Cloud Gaming, but that service faces strict monthly limits, which will make it difficult to play through the game in a timely fashion.
Fortunately, a GamesBeat report suggests gamers may not have to wait a full year for a PC release, though it remains unconfirmed.

articles.t: CD Projekt RED veut pour son prochain Witcher un bond comparable à celui réussi par GTA 6
articles.chapeau: Witcher 4 vise 2028 et un bond comparable à celui de GTA 6 face à GTA 5. CD Projekt RED promet des progrès visuels, mais aussi dans presque tous les domaines.
articles.txt:
Prendre le dernier Rockstar comme étalon, c’est choisir une comparaison particulièrement exigeante. Le studio polonais l’assume : sa prochaine aventure doit franchir un cap qui dépasse largement la seule qualité graphique.
Lors de la présentation des résultats du troisième trimestre de CD Projekt RED, Krzysztof Tkocz, analyste chez Erste, a interrogé Michał Nowakowski sur la possibilité de reproduire un saut comparable à celui séparant GTA 5 de GTA 6. Le codirecteur général a répondu par l’affirmative, sans se lancer dans une comparaison détaillée des deux jeux de Rockstar.
« Pensons-nous qu’il y aura un bond comparable entre The Witcher 3 et The Witcher 4 ? Je pense que oui. Cela fait 11 ans », a-t-il déclaré. Le dirigeant explique que les équipes travaillent à rendre le prochain épisode « nettement plus beau et amélioré dans pratiquement tous les aspects du jeu ».
La promesse porte donc autant sur le jeu lui-même que sur son rendu. Nowakowski indique que le studio a examiné le titre de Rockstar et constaté les différences avec son prédécesseur. Il ne détaille toutefois pas, dans cette intervention, les systèmes ou les mécaniques qui doivent matérialiser cette progression chez CD Projekt RED.
La comparaison intervient alors que GTA 6 bénéficie déjà d’un accueil exceptionnel. TechPowerUp rapporte un score de 99 sur Metacritic, 118 notes parfaites et des recettes de 3,79 milliards de dollars en une seule journée, soit environ 3,3 milliards d’euros à titre indicatif. Se mesurer à une telle référence place nécessairement les attentes très haut.
Nowakowski précise néanmoins que la sortie de GTA 6 n’a pas changé la manière dont CD Projekt RED aborde le développement. Il présente les productions du studio comme guidées par l’ambition plutôt que par le budget. The Witcher 4 vise actuellement une sortie en 2028 , ce qui laisse encore du temps avant de pouvoir confronter ces déclarations au résultat.
L’enjeu sera surtout de rendre ce saut perceptible au-delà des images. En engageant sa parole sur presque tous les aspects du jeu, CD Projekt RED élargit lui-même le terrain sur lequel son prochain épisode sera jugé : une avancée visuelle, même importante, ne suffira pas à remplir la promesse formulée devant les investisseurs.

articles.t: How the Irredeemable Criminal Profile Works - GTA 6 Guide - IGN
articles.chapeau: If you've gone on an extended rampage in GTA 6, you may have seen a warning telling you that your character's Criminal Profile is nearing
articles.txt:
If you've gone on an extended rampage in GTA 6, you may have seen a warning telling you that your character's Criminal Profile is nearing "Irredeemable". The warning makes this Criminal Profile sound very intense, so here's everything you need to know about this permanent Criminal Profile change in Grand Theft Auto VI.
When you’re close to being Irredeemable, time will slow down, and the Psycho emoji in the bottom-right corner will be shown on the player character profile picture. The emoji will then start to crack . You get two of these slow-motion emoji-cracking warnings if you continue to push your profile lower and lower, until eventually, the emoji will fracture permanently, and the muted purple of the Psycho emoji will be replaced with the grey Irredeemable .
There’s no coming back once you’ve hit the Irredeemable Criminal Profile. Irredeemable characters do not get any bonus Focus from any of their combat actions, they can’t surrender to the police, and there may even be more effects down the line as well.
While killing police repeatedly will contribute towards a Psycho profile, killing cops will give you much slower progress towards Irredeemable from that point. The fastest way to get your Criminal Profile to be Irredeemable is to repeatedly explode civilian vehicles and groups of civilians. Indiscriminately killing civilians over and over and over will take you from Psycho to the edge of Irredeemable, at which point you will receive a few warnings if you continue to push it.
While Irredeemable, it might be difficult to increase your relationship very much if your two characters have very different criminal profiles, but it is still possible to have relationships of any level while one or more of your characters are Irredeemable.
Beware: the only way to reverse this classification of Irredeemable is to load an earlier save.
There are five different Criminal Profiles that both Lucia and Jason can earn through your gameplay actions.
Lucia and Jason each have their own Criminal Profile, and the actions of one don’t affect the other. You can have a Professional Jason and have Lucia be an Irredeemable psychopath, or vice versa.
You can check each protagonist's Criminal Profile by opening the map with Touchpad / View , then pressing L1 / LB to tab over to Jason & Lucia. In here, press D-pad Left on the D-Pad to view more details about Jason and D-pad Right to see more about Lucia.
For more info on GTA 6's Criminal Profile mechanics or Sex and Romance status systems, check out IGN's official Grand Theft Auto VI Guide pages!

AFP Le nouvel opus de Grand Theft Auto, qui met en scène un couple de criminels, récompense désormais les comportements vertueux et les attentions amoureuses. Un changement de cap qui suscite la colère d’une partie des fans de la franchise.
Fini les prostituées, il faut désormais acheter des fleurs à sa compagne : la grande romance au cœur de l'histoire du nouveau GTA 6 a mis en colère certains fans, qui accusent la franchise d'avoir trahi ses origines et intégré une «bouillie féministe» .
En live sur la plateforme Twitch avec le célèbre streamer Anyme, le rappeur Leto a par exemple lâché la manette, refusant d'incarner «la racli» - une fille, en langage argotique. «Ce jeu est bon à jeter, CUCK simulateur» , s'est également énervé un joueur sur X, employant un terme issu des sphères masculinistes, désignant à la fois un cocu et, de façon très péjorative, une personne modérée politiquement ou de gauche. Un autre a qualifié le jeu de «bouillie féministe» . Et certains joueurs conservateurs sont d'autant plus énervés que le jeu lui-même tourne en dérision les influenceurs masculinistes et l'obsession de la droite américaine pour les personnes transgenres.
Grand Theft Auto 6, qui a signé un lancement «record» avec 3,8 milliards de dollars de ventes générés dès le jour de sa sortie d'après son éditeur Rockstar Games, reste un jeu où la violence est omniprésente. Le joueur incarne les personnages de Jason et Lucia, version moderne de Bonnie and Clyde, dans leurs vies de criminels à Vice City, réplique de Miami, pour s'assurer un meilleur avenir avec leur bébé.
Alors que les précédents volets se complaisaient dans le chaos, ce dernier opus se révèle moralement plus complexe. Dans le GTA d'origine, sorti en 1997, le fait de rouler sur des piétons et de détruire des véhicules était par exemple salué par des applaudissements. Désormais, le joueur doit entretenir la flamme entre les deux personnages qu'il incarne tour à tour, que ce soit en réparant la maison ou en achetant des fleurs et des bijoux. Un nouveau système d'honneur récompensant les bons comportements et décourageant la violence gratuite, associé à l'accent mis sur une vie saine et les tâches domestiques dans le jeu, marque également une rupture nette avec les précédents opus de la franchise.
Le joueur doit ainsi maintenir la condition physique des personnages qu'il incarne pour réussir des braquages, tandis que les actes de gentillesse envers des inconnus ou des gestes de civisme, comme ne pas jeter de déchets par terre, leur rapportent des points de concentration. D'après la presse spécialisée, soigner son couple et garder un profil de criminel «professionnel» , par opposition aux «violents» , «psychopathes» et «irrécupérables» , sont nécessaires pour débloquer la meilleure fin du jeu. Et pour la première fois depuis leur apparition dans GTA 3, sorti en 2001, les prostituées sont absentes du jeu.
Là où les précédents opus permettaient des rencontres sexuelles payantes, «GTA 6 est un jeu qui raconte l'histoire d'un couple dans une situation difficile, des amants en cavale» , a déclaré Rockstar dans un communiqué. «Même si nous avons beaucoup repris des précédents titres GTA, tout ce que nous avons intégré au VI l'a été pour servir l'esprit de l'histoire que nous souhaitions raconter» , a poursuivi le studio.
«Je ne dirais pas que c'est quelque chose de sain, mais c'est une histoire complète, avec laquelle les gens peuvent interagir d'une manière plus profonde, et à certains égards plus réfléchie» , a estimé auprès de l'AFP Andrew Przybylski, professeur en comportement humain et technologie à l'Oxford Internet Institute. Il a ajouté que l'industrie du jeu vidéo avait beaucoup évolué depuis les débuts de GTA, avec par exemple plus de joueuses, mais réfuté l'idée que le jeu ne serait plus «transgressif» . «La police de Miami ne va pas être contente» , a-t-il plaisanté.

articles.chapeau: Take-Two says GTA VI made $3.79B in day-one retail sales. See how that compares with GTA V, Endgame and the highest-grossing video games.
articles.txt:
Image: Rockstar Games Take-Two Interactive says Grand Theft Auto VI generated $3.79 billion in worldwide day-one retail sales , based on company estimates through the end of November 19, 2026. The publisher called it the biggest entertainment launch in history. That claim sets up a fair question for anyone tracking the highest-grossing video games: where does a single day of GTA VI sit next to everything that came before it?
The honest answer takes some care. A launch-day number and a lifetime revenue total measure different things, and the $3.79 billion figure is an internal estimate rather than an audited result. This analysis lays out what Take-Two confirmed, how the number stacks up against GTA V, Red Dead Redemption 2 and Avengers: Endgame , and which parts of the “highest-grossing game ever” story nobody can prove yet. We first covered the headline numbers in our report on GTA 6’s $3.79B day one , so this piece goes further into the history and the caveats.
Google · Preferred Sources Don't miss new tech stories on Google
Add Shattered once in the Google app and our stories show up in your news suggestions.
The verified facts are short. Rockstar Games and its parent, Take-Two Interactive Software (NASDAQ: TTWO), announced that Grand Theft Auto VI earned $3.79 billion in worldwide day-one retail sales. The game launched on November 19, 2026, and the estimate runs through the end of that day. Take-Two described the result as the biggest entertainment launch in history and said it set a new record for entertainment across any medium.
Several outlets carried the same announcement within hours. The Hollywood Reporter put the day-one sales figure in its headline, The Verge framed it as Rockstar’s own claim, and the Los Angeles Times ran it as the biggest entertainment launch ever. All of them trace back to the same Take-Two statement, so the coverage is wide but the underlying source is single.
That single-source detail matters. Nobody outside Take-Two has audited the $3.79 billion. The company has not published a price breakdown, a platform-by-platform split, a profit figure or a lifetime revenue total. Anything beyond the headline number is reporting or speculation, and this article labels it that way.
The wording is “worldwide day-one retail sales,” and the window closes at the end of November 19. Reporting around the announcement, including Deadline’s account of the figures, indicates the total includes copies sold before release. Kotaku’s coverage notes that 32.5 million copies sold in the pre-release period , and Reuters relayed the same unit count from Take-Two’s figures. So “day one” here is better read as “everything counted up to the close of launch day” than as 24 hours of walk-in sales.
That distinction does not make the number small. It does make comparisons trickier, because GTA V’s famous first-day figure and Hollywood opening weekends use their own windows and rules.
Take-Two calls the figure a company estimate. Public companies often refine such numbers in later filings, and the next quarterly report is where analysts will look for a firmer revenue line. Until then, treat $3.79 billion as the publisher’s claim, reported accurately by every outlet named above, and not as a settled accounting fact.
The cleanest way to see the scale is a side-by-side. The table below uses the figures from our research. The GTA V and Red Dead Redemption 2 numbers are the widely reported industry figures from their own launches, and the Hollywood number is the commonly cited worldwide opening weekend for Avengers: Endgame . The windows differ, so the multiples are a rough guide, not a precise ranking.
Even with generous allowances for the different windows, the gap is wide. GTA VI’s single day, as counted by Take-Two, exceeds GTA V’s first three days by roughly 3.8 times and the biggest Hollywood opening weekend in the comparison by about 3.1 times. Kotaku’s headline goes a step further and says GTA VI beat Avengers: Endgame ‘s lifetime box office by nearly $1 billion in 24 hours.
Rockstar is competing with its own past here. Grand Theft Auto V reportedly earned about $800 million in its first 24 hours in 2013 and passed $1 billion in retail sales within three days. Both numbers set records at the time.

articles.t: GTA 6: Where To Find Dolores The Snake After Chapter 1's Ending - SVG
articles.chapeau: Regardless how you feel about snakes, you'll probably care about what happens to Jason's beloved pet after the big finale to the first chapter of "GTA 6."
articles.txt:
Rockstar Games Add SVG on Google: Preferred Source Google Discover Contains spoilers for "Grand Theft Auto 6"
The excellent "Grand Theft Auto VI" doesn't quite start with a bang, but Chapter 1 certainly ends with one. Its final mission, "Home Sweet Home," forces Lucia Caminos to fight against two home invaders as she drops by Jason Duval's waterside house to grab some stuff. The dramatic fight in the burning building ends with Lucia barely escaping the place before it explodes, and once she comes to, she has to find out a way to escape the heavy police presence in the area. It's a dramatic mission where the player's focus is fully on Lucia's survival, the lost stash be damned. In the heat of the moment, it's easy to forget that Brian's snake Dolores was also in the house during the events. Was that it for the sympathetic reptile?
Fortunately, no. If you visit the burned ruins of Jason's Key Lento house later in the game, you can verify that Dolores is still very much out and about — in fact, she's only moved to ground level. You can find her hanging out in a nest underneath the house's stairs, and she even has a few eggs.
The fact that Dolores survives the house burning down is fitting, since the snake is a symbol of Jason's early-game mission to be better. Brian tasks Jason with taking care of the snake, and feeding it rewards the player with a nice little focus buff. This small, yet rewarding recurring task is one of the earliest signs of Jason's key arc in Chapter 1: He's trying to be a better person, who doesn't only take care of himself.
Rockstar Games As we find out over the course of "GTA VI" Chapter 1, Jason and Lucia's relationship fell apart before the events of the game, largely because Jason wasn't willing to let Lucia in on his lifestyle. We also learn that Jason regrets his past hesitancy to let things become more serious and start a family. Now he understands this was caused by his private concerns that his own bad upbringing would reflect on his own actions.
Much of Chapter 1 revolves around Jason trying to get his life as together as possible — not just for himself but for Lucia and, in the long run, their young son Tomás. This is why "GTA VI" has Jason fixing various projects around the house , and why the player has the option to get things like jewelry, flowers, and groceries for Lucia ahead of her release from prison. Jason's finally learning to be there for others, and feeding Dolores is pretty much the first thing the player can voluntarily do to this effect.
Of course, the material results of Jason's efforts go up in flames with the house, but at the end, it was just stuff. Jason has already learned to put in the work to improve himself, and he's proved that life can change. The fact that Dolores not only survives the events of Chapter 1 but is living her best life as a mother-to-be supports this theme: Even in the brutal world of "Grand Theft Auto VI," things can get better.

articles.chapeau: GTA 6 leak raises prospect of unofficial PC port and earlier official release
articles.txt:
조선비즈 구글 검색 먼저 보기 Rockstar Games' GTA Ⅵ(6) records approximately 5 trillion won in sales in just one day after its release. /Courtesy of Yonhap News Agency Hacked files from "Grand Theft Auto (GTA) 6," a crime action game considered this year's biggest hit, have been released, raising the likelihood that an unofficial PC version will emerge.
According to British gaming outlet Eurogamer on the 24th, Cyberleek, the anonymous hacker who breached Rockstar Games in August and leaked the game's entire development files, recently released the executable file for the Xbox version of GTA 6.
After leaking the full game build, Cyberleek had been receiving cryptocurrency donations while releasing stolen files and gameplay footage. Cyberleek had not released the executable (exe) file needed to run the game until making it public five days after the game's release.
A group of developers called "Project Leonida" downloaded the files released by Cyberleek and reportedly modified and ported the Xbox version to run on PCs with the help of the artificial intelligence (AI) tool Claude.
According to Eurogamer, one hacker reportedly managed to boot the game on a PC as far as the initial setup screen but failed to enter the game itself. They claim it will take about a week for the build to become playable on a PC.
GTA 6 was released worldwide on the 19th for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. Rockstar Games typically releases games on consoles first and follows with a PC version about a year later.
But amid growing concern about the August hack and the prospect of an unofficial port using AI, some expect the company to bring forward the PC version's release to the first quarter of next year.

The creepy IT Easter egg takes place in a West Ocean Beach elevator, but you can only trigger it during a short window at night. Here’s where to find Pennywise in GTA 6 and what to look for when you get there.
The Pennywise Easter egg in GTA 6 is inside the Haymarket Building in West Ocean Beach between 10 PM and 2 AM in-game. To make it easier to find, we’ve marked the building’s exact location on the Leonida map below.
Arrive at the Haymarket Building between 10 PM and 2 AM and walk into the lobby through the front entrance . You’ll know the Pennywise encounter is active if the elevator on the left has a “Sorry Out of Order” sign on it. You’ll also spot Pennywise’s iconic red balloon and hear his music playing.
If the sign is up, open the elevator next to it. You’ll see a bunch of creepy balloons floating inside. Step in and take the elevator up to the roof.
As the elevator goes up, the balloons will slowly start to pop and the lights will flicker out. Pennywise will then appear right in front of you and attack you with a machete. Okay, it’s not THE Pennywise, but it’s more like a Florida Man version of the cosmic entity.
After the jumpscare, step out of the elevator and pick up the Carnival Ticket on the floor . The reward is a coupon for a free pair of underpants, which is pretty fitting after what just happened in the elevator.
There’s no unique weapon to collect here , but if you’re a fan of Stephen King or IT , the Pennywise Easter egg is worth the trip to West Ocean Beach after dark. For more secret Easter eggs, check out our GTA 6 Ghost Ship Easter Egg guide .

articles.t: GTA 6 Mandy Actor Reacts To Going Viral: 'It's Bittersweet'
articles.chapeau: Lexie Shoaibi recently guested on Hasan Piker's Twitch channel
articles.txt:
Mandy is one of the first NPCs players run into in Grand Theft Auto 6 . Jason is sent to collect rent from her and she tries to come onto him despite his Mr. Freeze levels of cold disinterest. At one point he’s trying to unscrew the bolt for the sink trap when she comes back wearing nothing but a pink-trimmed leopard-print string bikini. Clips of the early encounter quickly went viral . Actor Lexie Shoaibi, who voices Mandy, said the instant internet fame has been “bittersweet.”
Like many video game characters, Mandy is modeled after one person but voiced by another. The model is Miami-based influencer Marissa DuBois. The voice belongs to Shoaibi, an actor and model who also promotes herself through Meta’s engagement-driven algorithm. She told Vulture that she auditioned for the role back around 2023, but it was never explicitly confirmed to her that it was for GTA 6 .
The context-less gig came with tons of NDAs, but Shoaibi found the performance part surprisingly inviting. She performed opposite Jason’s actor, Dylan Rourke, and said the whole experience felt a bit like an “off-Broadway theater production.” It wasn’t until years later, when she saw clips of streamers playing the game on November 18, that she realized what she’d appeared in and got to see the finished performance. Within 24 hours, Mandy was a thirst trap on every GTA subreddit.
“I think because I have some experience with online attention as a content creator, I’ve developed a pretty effective lens for seeing more good than bad,” Shoaibi said when asked about having the Gooner Eye of Sauron laser in on her. “There are weirdos out there, and they’re going to try to bring you down, so it’s important to stay around the people and the places that aren’t doing that. It’s easy enough to do, which I’m very grateful for. There’s enough support in my real-life community and online that I can say, ‘I could just hang out over here. I don’t actually need to go to the scary place.’ I’m living in the positive, for sure.”
The actor recently appeared on a Twitch charity stream with Hasan Piker, who she was put in contact with by a mutual friend. The 15 minutes of video game fame has led to a bunch of people impersonating her online as people try to chase clout in Mandy’s wake. “I don’t know how that happened,” Shoaibi told Piker (via IGN ). “People pretending to be me? It’s thrilling. Please stop, but it’s also so exciting. It’s sort of bittersweet.” She had previously put out a warning on her Instagram about fake accounts trying to pose as her.
The most surprising moment during Jason’s initial encounter with Mandy is when he discovers the cause of the clogged sink: a human finger. She takes it from him so fast that you can easily miss what it actually is, but clues scattered around the rest of her house reveal she might be something of a serial killer. Shoaibi said she had no idea about that part of the character ahead of time.
“When we were recording, it wasn’t specifically clarified or intended for me to base my acting around,” she told Vulture . “On the motion-capture set, it was just a little colorful block. I think we played with ‘finger,’ but it might also at one point have been ‘a toe’–not that that’s so different. But I wasn’t led to believe it was an important clue to who she is and what she’s up to. It was just some weirdness in the sink. That’s what I got.”

articles.t: 5 Hidden Events And Secrets You Might Miss In GTA 6 - BGR
articles.chapeau: Rockstar has a knack for hiding bizarre little surprises in its games, and "GTA 6" is full of them from the very first chapter.
articles.txt:
LarysaP/Shutterstock Add BGR on Google: Preferred Source Google Discover "Grand Theft Auto 6" is finally here and giving players a taste of what the world of Leonida has to offer Jason and Lucia. While most of us might have been working our way through the game's story — or even getting distracted building up Jason's muscles — if you really want to find some of the game's more interesting tidbits, you're going to need to go a bit off the beaten path.
Because you can unlock the full map in "GTA 6" early on, most of the hidden events that you can come across can be found at any point in the game. This means the game's first chapter is a perfect chance to start exploring and seeing what secrets Leonida has to offer. While there are dozens that we know of, these are five of our favorite hidden events and secrets you can uncover in "GTA 6." Of course, some of them may be tied to later parts of the game, or require visiting at certain times of the day, which we'll note below if it matters to the event we're highlighting.
YouTube / KingAlexHD Random events are a big part of what makes "GTA 6" feel so alive, and one of the strangest you can come across involves a polar bear being trucked over to a zoo. While there isn't any specific place you'll need to visit for this one — several reports have put it on Vice City's highways, near the center of the city — you'll basically want to drive around until you spot a group of protesters all huddled around a truck that has been forced to pull over.
The protesters will be chanting something like "Oppressor!" at the driver, and when you pull up, you have two options to choose from. You can tell the driver to run the protesters over, or you can help the group open the doors to the truck and free the polar bear. The choice is up to you. But if you do open the doors, you'll see bits about the polar bear later on in the game's news and social media. Unfortunately, tracking the bear down after freeing it doesn't appear to do anything, and neither will killing it.
YouTube / Maka91Productions "GTA 6" has a ton of great music for you to jam out to while you explore Leonida. But what if we told you that there are actually two secret playlists you can unlock by exploring Vice City and finding a couple of posters? You'll need to unlock both of the playlists if you want to get 100% completion on "GTA 6," but even if that's not your goal right now, going ahead and unlocking them gives you some extra music to listen to.
You can start collecting these posters as early as the game's first chapter, though you will need to wait until you get access to the Jack of Hearts recording studio in Chapter 3 to completely unlock one of the playlists, called "The Sniper of La Perle." This playlist has 22 tracks from Kodak Black for players to jam out to while running around. The second playlist, called "The Vault Radio," only requires one poster to unlock. If you want help finding all the posters, PowerPyx has a really detailed guide with screenshots and everything.
YouTube / GRANDOS Rockstar has also filled Leonida with a slew of animals you can come across. While you can hunt some of them later in the game, there are others that might surprise you if you aren't careful. In fact, petting a cat or dog can actually give Jason a boost of Focus, while feeding the couple's pet snake in Chapter 1 can do the same thing. There are also over 60 bird species for eagle-eyed players to spot and log. Of course, not all of the animals you come across are going to be friendly — and if you aren't careful, stealing the wrong vehicle might even cause you to run into some not-so-friendly animals in the process.
One player shared a clip that shows Jason stealing a car without realizing there is a cat in the back seat. Once he starts driving away, the cat jumps on him and then begins to claw at his neck until he throws it out. Another clip showed a player popping open a car's trunk in a parking lot only for a giant snake to come flying up out of it. And, of course, you can't forget about the alligators. They aren't simply a static part of the environment — get too close to the shore and one might just charge Jason and try to take him out. You can always use the animals to your advantage, too, by doing things such as feeding NPCs to them.

articles.chapeau: I was not ready to get so emotional over a coffee table
articles.txt:
Grand Theft Auto 6 features as much shootin’, stealin’, and drug runnin’ as you’d expect from the latest entry in a series named after a felony. However, some players have been caught off-guard by just how much the early game is all about the more mundane parts of life. Namely, you gotta do a bunch of chores around the house . In many ways, GTA 6 is as much of an everyday life sim as it is a game about committing crimes.
Jason repairs the steps leading up to his and Lucia’s home, fixes a railing, buys groceries, orders flowers, paints the walls of their bedroom, and more to prepare for Lucia’s arrival from prison. All those chores might seem less thrilling than the opening hours you’d expect in a big-budget action game. But it turns out they set up a tragic heartbreak I simply did not see coming.
Chapter 1 involves Jason and Lucia trying to get work from Mattia, the shady boyfriend of Kat, a mother-to-be whom Lucia befriended in prison. Part of that involves a standout sequence set to a Carly Rae Jepsen banger before Lucia gets lost in orgy central. (Vice City, y’all!) Bro, Mattia promises a job that could pay ten grand, bro. They just have to grab a bag from a locker and deliver it, bro.
Red flags abound, but Jason and Lucia go along for the ride, which quickly results in their arrest. Crooked cops show up, the couple gets into a shootout, and Jason gets grievously wounded while the couple struggle to keep hold over a bag containing who knows what.
GTA 6 does a great job of showing how various systems, both governmental and societal, are against Jason and Lucia, and that shines through here. In Jason and Lucia, Mattia sees a pair of not prospective partners, but a down-on-their-luck couple he can easily exploit — and they’re all too willing to play into his hands. Mattia leverages their desperation, even making them play dress up with Lucia in a platinum blonde wig and Jason in one of Mattia’s gaudy shirts, so they’d take the fall for whatever shady shit Mattia is up to. Clearly, he knew the danger surrounding this bag with shady cops and an organized outfit after it and gladly fed Jason and Lucia to the wolves.
They escape, but their horrible night has only just begun. Lucia takes Jason to his friend Cal, who brings Jason — and the mysterious bag — to the hospital. (Lucia later learns the hospital took everything from the couple’s BuckMe checking account as payment. America!) Lucia heads home to recover Jason’s stash, and tragedy strikes.
Image: Rockstar Games via Polygon Upon entering their home, Lucia is jumped by masked criminals searching for that bag. Suddenly, the home Jason and Lucia built is now the arena for Lucia’s fight for her life. Flames engulf the sliding glass door that led to a patio where Jason would work out and the couple would hold one another while sipping their coffee and enjoying the morning sun. Those relaxing mornings are no more.
Tommy’s future crib that Jason bought during his video game night with Cal ? Destroyed. A goon even tosses Lucia into it at one point, adding insult to injury. Where Tommy would have slept soundlessly — with a giant stuffed teddy in the corner — is now burning up. Also burning up is the hope that Jason and Lucia will get to live a normal life with Tommy, which the crib represented. Maybe in another life Jason and Lucia would have told Mattia to eat shit, bro, stayed patient, and welcomed Tommy to their little house on stilts in due time. Not in this life, however.

articles.chapeau: Les 7 meilleures armes uniques et silencieuses gratuites dès les Chapitres 1 et 2 de GTA 6 : Assassin Nipper .38, M306 TMR et emplacements exacts.
articles.txt:
Dès les premières heures dans Grand Theft Auto VI , l’armurerie Ammu-Nation coûte cher et les silencieux restent longtemps hors de portée de votre portefeuille. Pourtant, Leonida cache plus de 120 variantes d’ armes uniques gratuites équipées d’usine avec des accessoires tactiques (silencieux, lunettes, viseurs point rouge) et des finitions exclusives.
En suivant un itinéraire précis entre les Permit Keys, Wetman Bay, Balsero et Pelican Valley, vous pouvez récupérer sept pièces majeures dès les Chapitres 1 et 2 sans débourser un dollar. Voici les emplacements exacts, les prérequis et les atouts de chacune.
Dans le monde ouvert, chaque arme unique se repère grâce à une icône d’arme dorée et s’affiche en jaune dans votre roue d’équipement. Vous pouvez suivre votre collection complète via le menu Progression > Armes > Variantes , qui recense 127 modèles au total.
L’avantage décisif tient à leur statut permanent : dès que vous ramassez une variante unique une seule fois, elle est débloquée définitivement pour Jason Duval et Lucia Caminos . Si vous la laissez tomber ou si vous finissez à l’hôpital, vous la retrouverez gratuitement dans le coffre de votre voiture ou au casier d’armes, comme expliqué dans notre guide complet du fonctionnement des armes dans GTA 6 .
C’est la première arme à sécuriser dès que l’exploration libre s’ouvre. Cette variante Scorpio du Nipper .38 arrive avec un silencieux monté d’origine , ce qui permet d’aborder les premières infiltrations sans déclencher d’alerte ni dépenser plusieurs milliers de dollars en boutique.
Prenez un bateau vers les Permit Keys , au nord d’Abismo Key et à l’est de l’aéroport Southwind. Sur la pointe sud-est de l’archipel, repérez l’épave échouée d’un vieux navire espion. Grimpez sur le pont, activez le mode Focus si besoin et ouvrez la petite trappe de plancher pour empocher le pistolet.
Profitez de votre passage dans l’archipel pour remonter jusqu’à l’ îlot le plus au nord des Permit Keys . Ce fusil à pompe à canon court signé Fortune & Son (calibre 12, chargeur de 5 cartouches) arbore une carcasse vert mat ornée d’un papillon tête-de-mort.
Aucune énigme ni fusillade n’est requise : repérez le bateau de contrebandiers incliné sur la plage et fouillez le sable juste à côté de la coque pour le ramasser.
Restez vigilant pendant la mission « Don Gone » du Chapitre 1. Ce revolver Hawk & Little unique se trouve à l’intérieur du coffre de la voiture rouge de Donnie .
Pensez impérativement à ouvrir le coffre et à récupérer l’arme avant que le véhicule ne soit détruit ou que la séquence ne vous fasse avancer. Si vous terminez la mission sans l’avoir pris, ce modèle peut être manqué définitivement sur votre sauvegarde.
Variante exclusive de la carabine Wortham W-22, ce modèle combine un silencieux intégré et une optique de précision idéale pour éliminer les sentinelles d’un tir silencieux à la tête.
Direction Wetman Bay , dans le secteur des cabanes de pêche tenues par les Kingfishers. Rejoignez les pontons en bateau, neutralisez les gardes armés qui protègent l’opération illégale, puis entrez dans la maison principale du quai : la mallette contenant le Kingfishers W-22 repose directement sur le comptoir de la cuisine.
Dès que vous circulez librement autour de Vice City, foncez à Balsero , à l’ouest de la ville près du stand de tir Griffin Shooting Range. L’arme est dissimulée dans l’ entrepôt Black Eagle collé au magasin Ammu-Nation local, mais elle n’est pas disponible à la vente.
Passez par la porte de garage ouverte en vous préparant à neutraliser les employés hostiles, puis contournez le camion vers le fond du bâtiment. Prenez impérativement le contrôle de Lucia : son gabarit plus fin lui permet de se glisser entre les caisses et le grillage de la cage arrière sans devoir déplacer les palettes au chariot élévateur. À l’intérieur, la mallette renferme cette variante du Hillinger M306 TMR dotée d’un silencieux intégré et d’une lunette à zoom réglable .
À Pelican Valley (secteur Gullet Marsh, au sud-ouest de Hamlet et au nord du camp des Kingfishers), un seul arrêt en hydroglisseur rapporte deux pièces lourdes complémentaires sans aucun affrontement obligatoire.
Tant que vous explorez cette zone marécageuse, n’hésitez pas à pousser jusqu’au poste de recherche abandonné tout proche pour déverrouiller le pistolet-mitrailleur militaire grâce à notre soluce de l’énigme Pelican Valley Outpost (Crabshack VF5) . Plus au nord, Port Gellhorn abrite aussi deux autres variantes gratuites

articles.chapeau: Project Leonida
articles.txt:
Project Leonida, a fan effort to recompile the leaked GTA 6 Xbox build for Windows, disappeared from Discord and GitHub after showing early PC startup footage. Its 15-year-old lead quit, blaming Rockstar for the Discord takedown and citing personal pressures; Rockstar has not commented publicly.

Rockstar's response to the first serious attempt at a GTA 6 PC port appears to have landed just as hard as its warning against AI-assisted PC clones and reverse engineering.
Project Leonida, the biggest fan recompilation effort, has been scrapped after its Discord server and GitHub repository vanished, just hours after it showed the game getting further than anyone expected.
As we covered, notorious leaker Cyberleek released a near-complete Xbox build of the game , then followed up on November 23 with the missing executable . Within hours, Leonida's Discord reported that "the game almost boots," with a black screen and cut-off audio. Later footage appeared to show the full opening sequence and first-time setup running on PC.
By then, the project had been working with help from Claude AI to recompile the leaked Xbox build for Windows. A few hours later, it was gone. Lead developer NotRexed announced he was quitting. "I quit, guys. I'm sorry. I really want to make cool stuff, but every single time shit happens that I can't control, so I'm stepping away."
In a follow-up, he blamed Rockstar for the server takedown, but said it was only part of the reason. "Like I've said before, I'm a 15 year-old kid. Managing school and sports is hard enough without having middle-aged men yell and complain to you on Discord. Goodbye."
The Discord server had almost 180,000 members when it went offline, and NotRexed says he has been banned from Discord for two years. His original GitHub repository is also gone, though clones made by others appear to remain online.
Rockstar hasn't commented publicly, so its involvement rests on the developer's own account. Still, it would fit a pattern. Take-Two recently shut down the unofficial GTA V Android and Switch ports from Paralympics Productions with a cease-and-desist. There are also Reddit reports that Rockstar is going after other GTA 6 Discord servers, including one said to have around six million members, though that is unconfirmed.

articles.t: Rockstar Games kills unauthorized 'GTA 6' PC port, for obvious reasons
articles.chapeau: Just wait for the official PC version of the game to come out.
articles.txt:
Don't try to port Grand Theft Auto VI to PC yourself — or you'll potentially find yourself in big legal trouble.
GTA 6 may finally be out on Xbox and PlayStation 5, but that doesn't help out the PC gaming faithful, who still have much longer to wait for their version of the game.
As a result, some impatient gamers have recently attempted to create PC ports of the game themselves. Notorious GTA 6 leaker, Cyberleek, also recently released an executable .exe file of the Xbox build of the game, which helped those efforts. Even without Cyberleek, these efforts were probably inevitable, as new AI tools have led to a surge in PS5 jailbreaks and unauthorized ports of classic video games.
However, Rockstar Games' parent company, Take-Two Interactive, clearly does not approve of these unofficial attempts to bring GTA 6 to PC ahead of schedule. On Monday, the company had the biggest GTA 6 PC port project, known as Leonida, taken down. So far, GTA 6 has generated billions of dollars, and the PC version could bring in billions more. And when it comes to protecting their IP, Take-Two and Rockstar aren't messing around.
GitHub, where the project was hosted, posted a Digital Millennium Copyright Act (DMCA) notice it received from Take-Two.
"We are the IP Enforcement Team for Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc., parent company of Rockstar Games," the notice reads. "We are writing to submit a takedown request regarding ItsNotRexed's GitHub repository and the 2900+ forks attached to it that infringes upon Take-Two's copyrighted works and facilitates copyright infringement of Rockstar Games title, Grand Theft Auto VI."

"On November 20, 2026, stolen game files from an Xbox Series build of Grand Theft Auto VI were publicly distributed," the takedown notice reads. "The following day, this Leonida repository opened with the purpose of running the Xbox Series version of GTA VI on PC. Its README requires Xbox Series game files as input."
According to Take-Two, Leonida attempts to get around the IP issues by instructing project contributors to "bring your own files."
"This is intentionally misleading," Take-Two explains, pointing out that the files in question are the unauthorized GTA 6 files leaked by Cyberleek.
As our colleagues at PCMag point out , this is just one of many unauthorized projects attempting to bring GTA 6 to PC before the official version comes out. (Disclosure: Mashable and PCMag are both owned by the same parent company, Ziff Davis.) Other projects have reportedly managed to get the game's opening scene running on PC. Another has an extremely degraded version of the game running on Mac.
According to the Leonida project admin , Take-Two also successfully had the Discord server for the GTA 6 porting project taken down as well, so it does seem like the company is going to ramp up its takedowns of any attempted GTA 6 ports.
GTA 6 for PC has no official release date. However, GameBeat recently reported that the PC version may be released in early 2027, well before most gamers expected.

Cyberleek pushes GTA 6 PC efforts forward with the Xbox build .exe release
articles.chapeau: While the official launch date for GTA 6 on PC remains uncertain, the leaked Xbox build might help bridge the gap for eager fans.
articles.txt:
Cyberleek has released the missing executable for the leaked 209GB Grand Theft Auto 6 Xbox build ahead of schedule, giving modders and reverse-engineering groups another piece of the puzzle as they work toward getting the game running on PC. The release follows a cryptocurrency fundraising campaign tied to a $15 million meme coin market cap target, which was later reduced to $6 million.
The original Xbox files began circulating on November 19 , but the package lacked an essential .exe file, preventing anyone from attempting to launch the build. Cyberleek had initially promised to distribute the missing executable once tonce the November 23rd deadline passed,. However, the file started appearing on piracy websites just before the countdown expired .
Although its arrival is a significant development for people examining the leaked build, it does not mean GTA VI is suddenly playable on Windows. Cyberleek previously predicted that developers could produce a bootable PC version within a week, potentially through emulation or by adapting the game to run natively.
Neither approach is straightforward, as developers still face substantial technical challenges, including shader translation , memory management, and adapting the game's software environment to Windows. One such open-source compatibility layer project, VIctory , aims to translate GPU shaders and recreate console-specific features so GTA VI 's Xbox x86-64 code can run directly on Windows. Anyone struggling to keep track of the numerous projects can now follow their progress in one place on PortWatchVI .
Cyberleek also included a text document alongside the executable, reiterating the motivations behind the leak and the cryptocurrency campaign. According to the message, previous GTA 6 gameplay leaks deliberately avoided major story spoilers because the intention was not to ruin the experience for players. Instead, Cyberleek directed criticism toward Rockstar Games and its parent company, Take-Two Interactive, particularly over the delayed arrival of a dedicated PC version.
For now, the executable represents another development in the ongoing effort to examine the leaked Xbox build, rather than an immediate route to playing GTA 6 on PC. Whether the wider project delivers anything beyond the current leaks remains to be seen.

In September 2022, 17-year-old Kurtaj, a member of the Lapsus$ group, stole and published 90 videos of early GTA 6 gameplay under the alias TeaPotUberHacker. The footage, nearly an hour in total, revealed Lucia as one of the game’s playable characters. Rockstar said the studio had planned to reveal this detail later. Kurtaj also tried to extort the company, threatening to publish the game’s source code.
Rockstar estimated the cost of dealing with the hack’s aftermath at around $5 million. Studio employees spent thousands of working hours on recovery. The case also involved attacks on BT and EE, Revolut, and Uber. According to prosecutors, the Revolut hack affected the data of thousands of customers, while Uber’s costs exceeded $2,8 million.
In 2023, a jury found that Kurtaj had carried out the hacks. By then, experts had deemed him unfit to stand trial. In December, the court ordered Kurtaj to be detained indefinitely in a secure hospital. Following a reassessment, the court overturned the hospitalization order in January 2026. Kurtaj was transferred to prison, where he awaited further proceedings.
On November 16, Kurtaj pleaded guilty to six charges, including fraud, computer-related offenses, and illegally possessing a phone in prison. At sentencing, the court reduced his term from nine years to seven to account for his hospitalization. The court then credited him for time in custody, and Kurtaj was released that same day.
Kurtaj will serve the remainder of his sentence in the community under supervision. He could be returned to prison if he breaches the conditions of his release. Judge Mark Turner warned Kurtaj not to return to hacking.
The BBC reported that a separate five-year order restricts his online activity and bars him from using Telegram and Discord. In its sentencing statement, the City of London Police said it intended to seek such an order.
Kurtaj was released four days after GTA 6 launched on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. Take-Two estimates that worldwide retail sales of the game reached $3,79 billion on its first day.

articles.chapeau: GTA 6 accusé de « wokisme » : Lucia et Jason cristallisent la colère masculiniste. Analyse des représentations et des enjeux économiques mondiaux.
articles.txt:
Avec 3,79 milliards de dollars de ventes mondiales dès sa première journée de commercialisation, Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA 6) signe le plus grand lancement de l’histoire du divertissement, selon son éditeur. Mais le jeu vidéo est aussi devenu la cible d’influenceurs masculinistes qui accusent Rockstar Games d’avoir cédé au « wokisme ». En cause : une héroïne indépendante, Lucia Caminos, et un personnage masculin, Jason Duval, qui témoigne de l’affection à sa compagne. Une polémique révélatrice de la diffusion des discours masculinistes dans la culture populaire, de leur économie et de leur conception des rapports entre les femmes et les hommes.
Dans un jeu vidéo où les joueurs peuvent incarner des criminels, commettre des braquages et affronter les forces de l’ordre, offrir des fleurs à sa compagne serait-il devenu un acte subversif ? Depuis la sortie mondiale de GTA 6, le 19 novembre 2026, plusieurs influenceurs de la manosphère américaine dénoncent les choix narratifs de Rockstar Games, accusant le studio d’avoir sacrifié l’identité masculine de la franchise au profit du féminisme et de l’inclusivité.
Lancée en 1997, la série Grand Theft Auto a longtemps suscité des controverses en raison de sa violence, de ses représentations sexualisées des femmes et de la possibilité de recourir à la prostitution. Près de trente ans plus tard, la polémique s’est déplacée : c’est désormais la représentation d’une masculinité moins dominatrice qui provoque l’indignation d’une partie de ses détracteurs.
Treize ans après la sortie de GTA V, Rockstar Games a choisi de placer au cœur de son nouvel opus un couple de criminels évoluant dans un État américain fictif inspiré de la Floride. Lucia Caminos, ancienne détenue d’origine latino-américaine, et Jason Duval, ancien militaire, doivent coopérer pour survivre dans un environnement particulièrement violent.
Lucia marque une évolution importante dans l’histoire des principaux épisodes de la franchise. Alors que les femmes ont souvent occupé des rôles secondaires ou hypersexualisés dans GTA, elle dispose de ses propres ambitions, prend des décisions et participe pleinement à l’action.
Avant même la commercialisation du jeu, le magazine américain Wired avait documenté la multiplication des accusations de « wokisme » visant Rockstar Games. Certains internautes dénonçaient notamment la place accordée aux femmes et aux minorités, ainsi que les changements supposés dans les orientations éditoriales du studio.
Depuis la sortie du jeu, c’est également la relation entre les deux protagonistes qui concentre les critiques. Jason peut offrir des fleurs à Lucia, organiser des soirées en amoureux, l’accompagner dans certaines activités quotidiennes ou participer à l’aménagement de leur logement.
La disparition de la possibilité de recourir à la prostitution, présente dans la franchise depuis GTA III en 2001, alimente également les accusations de censure. Certains détracteurs reprochent au scénario de privilégier la fidélité du personnage masculin.
GTA 6 conserve pourtant les éléments caractéristiques de la série : violence explicite, criminalité, nudité et univers destiné aux adultes. Ce n’est donc pas tant la disparition de la transgression qui est en cause que l’évolution de certaines représentations des rapports entre les sexes.
Le streamer américain Asmongold, de son vrai nom Zack Hoyt, a qualifié GTA 6 de « cuck simulator », une expression particulièrement révélatrice du vocabulaire de la manosphère. Dérivé de l’anglais cuckold , signifiant littéralement « cocu », le terme est employé pour disqualifier les hommes considérés comme soumis aux femmes ou insuffisamment virils.
Myron Gaines, figure du podcast masculiniste Fresh & Fit , est allé plus loin en contestant la place même des femmes dans l’univers du jeu vidéo. Dans une intervention du 21 novembre, il a défendu l’idée que certaines sphères, dont les jeux vidéo, devraient rester réservées aux hommes. Ces déclarations ont été recensées par Media Matters for America dans une publication du 24 novembre.
Jason présente pourtant de nombreux attributs traditionnellement associés à la virilité : il est musclé, ancien militaire et capable de s’imposer dans un environnement criminel. Mais sa puissance physique ne semble pas suffisante aux yeux de certains détracteurs dès lors qu’il accorde de l’importance aux besoins et aux décisions de sa compagne.
Le vocabulaire employé par ces communautés numériques traduit une conception particulièrement hiérarchi

articles.t: « Une surprise totale »… Une chanson de Sylvie Vartan explose les compteurs grâce à GTA 6
articles.chapeau: Sylvie Vartan n'avait jamais joué à un jeu vidéo. La voilà pourtant au cœur de Vice City : « Danse ta vie », diffusé dans GTA 6, a vu ses écoutes bondir de plus de 2.500% sur Spotify
articles.txt:
Personne ne l’avait vu venir, et surtout pas elle. À 82 ans, Sylvie Vartan voit un morceau de 1983, « Danse ta vie », repartir à l’assaut des classements grâce à « GTA 6 ». Le jeu vidéo de Rockstar, lancé jeudi, a déjà séduit plus de 39 millions de joueurs uniques, plébiscité autant pour son scénario et le réalisme de ses personnages que pour sa bande-son omniprésente.
Les chiffres donnent le vertige. Selon Spotify , les écoutes du titre ont bondi de plus de 2.500 % dans le monde par rapport à la semaine précédente, avec un compteur qui s’affole dès le 20 novembre, au lendemain de la sortie du jeu. Le morceau est surtout plébiscité en France, mais aussi aux États-Unis , en Allemagne et au Canada : un raz-de-marée pour une chanson vieille de plus de quarante ans.
Dans GTA 6, la chanson tourne sur Kaleidoscope FM , l’une des vingt radios de Vice City, la ville où se déroule l’action. Elle y côtoie quelque 800 morceaux, ainsi que la bande-son composée par le duo électro français Justice. Sortie en 1983, « Danse ta vie » est une reprise en français de « What a Feeling » d’Irene Cara, tube emblématique du film « Flashdance ».
Principale intéressée, la chanteuse ne cache pas sa stupeur : « Ça a été une surprise totale, donc c’est absolument génial de savoir qu’une chanson que je chantais il y a quelques années a voyagé un peu partout et va encore renaître ». L’interprète de « La plus belle pour aller danser » (1964), aux plus de 40 millions de disques vendus, assure n’avoir rien su à l’avance de cette présence dans le jeu.
Ce titre fut sa chanson d’ouverture au Palais des congrès de Paris : « Je cherchais une chanson sur laquelle je pouvais danser […]. Ce sont des bons souvenirs qui reviennent ! »
Déjà virale en 2025 avec « La Maritza », la pionnière du rock français n’a pourtant jamais touché à la manette. Elle compte s’y mettre, « peut-être », même si elle n’a « pas trop le temps ».
